highlights: Connect and set up your machine from the compact top bar. Jog controls stay above the other machine tools, with scrolling that keeps them reachable in smaller windows.
Save material-test settings, result notes and photos together, turn selected test cells into reusable recipes, and compare recipe settings before applying them.
Preview shape combinations before applying them, keep their source paths editable, and organise artwork with named groups and drag-and-drop.
Organise projects into sheets, regenerate saved arrays, and keep batch data, serials and reviewed variants fixed when reopening a production run.
After Abort, responsive controllers recover on the same connection. Delayed startup replies get clearer messages, and later resets retain the first stop or fault result.
Your selected machine and hardware settings return next session. New starts a fresh job, and opened CNC job settings no longer replace your saved machine choice.
